title: Entangled in Time — The Quest for the Quantum Key (Kids Sci-Fi Adventure)
description:
Join Elara, Ziva, Teddybot, and Pranza as they soar through space and accidentally fall into a mysterious time vortex!

In this exciting kids adventure, the team explores ancient worlds, solves glowing riddles, and climbs a mountain temple to find the legendary Key of Quantum Entanglement.

Perfect for young explorers who love science, friendship, and magical adventures!
